liquefaction.source: California Geological Survey, Seismic Hazard Zones (liquefaction)
liquefaction.attribution: California Geological Survey, Seismic Hazard Zones. The official zone maps govern (Pub. Res. Code §2690 et seq.).

landslide.source: California Geological Survey, Seismic Hazard Zones (earthquake-induced landslide)
landslide.attribution: California Geological Survey, Seismic Hazard Zones. The official zone maps govern.

unevaluated.source: California Geological Survey, Seismic Hazard Zones (areas not evaluated)
unevaluated.attribution: California Geological Survey, areas not yet evaluated for seismic hazard zones.

faultZones.source: California Geological Survey, Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones
faultZones.attribution: California Geological Survey, Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones. The official zone maps govern (Pub. Res. Code §2621 et seq.).

coastalZone.source: California Coastal Commission, Coastal Zone polygon
coastalZone.attribution: California Coastal Commission, Coastal Zone (cadastral) polygon. The certified Coastal Zone Boundary maps govern.

fhszSra.source: CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zones, State Responsibility Area (2023)
fhszSra.attribution: CAL FIRE, Fire Hazard Severity Zones in the State Responsibility Area (effective April 1, 2024).

fhszLra.source: CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zones, Local Responsibility Area (map of March 24, 2025)
fhszLra.attribution: CAL FIRE (Office of the State Fire Marshal), Fire Hazard Severity Zones in the Local Responsibility Area, map of March 24, 2025. Local adoption by ordinance governs.

criticalHabitat.source: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Critical Habitat (final designations)
criticalHabitat.attribution: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, final critical habitat designations (50 CFR Part 17). The Federal Register designation governs.

airports.source: Caltrans Division of Aeronautics, Airport Boundaries
airports.attribution: Caltrans Division of Aeronautics, Airport Boundaries.
